description:
The purpose of this amendment is the following: 

 The purpose of this modification is to: 

 1. Extend the proposal due date to 12-18-2026 to allow time for project document updates. 

 2. Interested parties are encouraged to regularly check back for updates as the requirement will change. 

  

 This project involves the repair and resurfacing of three parking lots on the Arapaho and Roosevelt National Forest and Pawnee National Grassland including crack sealing, pavement patching, seal coating and re-striping. 

  
NAICS code 237310 - Highway, Street, and bridge Construction as a 100% SB Set Aside. 
Size standard $45 Million. 
PSC Code Y1LB - CONSTRUCTION OF HIGHWAYS, ROADS, STREETS, BRIDGES, 

 Questions Due: November 6th, 2026 at 14:00 Eastern Standard Time(EST). 

 Quotes Due:November 23rd, 2026 at 14:00 Eastern standard Time (EST). 

  
All questions and quotes relating to this Solicitation shall be submitted to 
Contract Specialist, Jordan Carlsen at Jordan.Carlsen@usda.gov by the deadlines 
stated above. Late quotes will be rejected.
